name: Eighth Bastion (CGH Earth)
summary: Eighth Bastion is a CGH Earth boutique hotel in Fort Kochi themed on the area's Dutch history. Its building mixes colonial and contemporary styles and sits close to the art studios and Biennale venues.
highlights: Boutique hotel themed on Fort Kochi's Dutch history
Tuk-tuk tours of Fort Kochi's lanes and churches
Close to the art studios and Kochi-Muziris Biennale venues
Run by CGH Earth, a Kerala hotel group

photos.alt: A model sailing ship in the hotel's lobby
